comment: ANTUMBRA kleos cross-validation vectors, generated by code/scripts/gen_kleos_vectors.py (independent Python implementation of ADR-003 and ADR-015). Regenerate with the generator; both implementations must agree bit for bit.

state.name: a fresh identity grows and saturates
a layer at zero with no gain stays at zero
a dead tenure layer never grows again
a sponsor is heavier than a witness
the wall of time, from below and from above
a dead layer cannot sit even with the score
an elder crosses the threshold honestly
fraud halves the deed and empties the echo
the witness weight crosses its floor exactly

draw.name: a full era draw, sixty candidates, fifty-five seats
a short pool draws every candidate
a pool that falls to zero weight stops drawing

draw_rejected.name: a pool with no weight at all
